title: EHAL Setpoint-API (M1)
description: Limit/schedule setpoints only. ESS limits in W (non-negative magnitudes); EVCS max current in A. At least one setpoint field required.

set_ess_charge_power_limit.description: Max ESS charge power in W (magnitude).

set_ess_discharge_power_limit.description: Max ESS discharge power in W (magnitude).

set_evcs_max_current.description: Max EV charge current in A.
